nodes.description: Private address state variable holding the contract owner.
Public uint256 registration fee, initialized to 0.1 ether.
Public mapping(address => bool) tracking registered users.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, modifiers, mapping keys and ETH recipient.
Constructor setting owner = msg.sender and registrationFee = 0.1 ether.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts.
onlyOwner setter that writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner setter that writes the registrationFee state variable.
Payable function requiring msg.value >= registrationFee and setting isUserRegistered[msg.sender] = true.
onlyOwner function transferring the whole contract balance to msg.sender.
Address parameter of setNewOwner written into the owner state variable.
Uint256 parameter of setNewRegistrationPrice written into registrationFee.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the constructor and compared against owner in the onlyOwner modifier.
constructor writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier consumes msg.sender in the require(msg.sender == owner) check.
onlyOwner modifier reads the owner state variable for the authorization check.
setNewOwner writes the owner state variable, guarded by onlyOwner.
_newOwner parameter is written into the owner state variable.
setNewOwner takes _newOwner as its input parameter.
setNewRegistrationPrice writes the registrationFee state variable.
setNewRegistrationPrice takes _newFee as its input parameter.
getOwner reads and returns the owner state variable.
register reads registrationFee in the require(msg.value >= registrationFee) check.
register uses msg.sender as the caller-supplied identity for registration.
register writes isUserRegistered[msg.sender] = true in the mapping state variable.
withdraw authorization depends on msg.sender through the onlyOwner modifier.
withdraw executes the external ETH transfer unsafe operation to msg.sender.
The ETH transfer sends value to the caller-controlled msg.sender, which may execute fallback logic.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is only used as the input parameter of setNewOwner and directly flows into the owner state variable; it has no independent role.
_newFee is only used as the input parameter of setNewRegistrationPrice and directly flows into registrationFee; it has no independent role.
